summary: The page cache of a KRFFS root mounted from a disk on the AHCI controller of the q35 machine, function 2 of the multi-function device 31, as on the Lenovo; the program is tests/blockprobe.c

cases.behavior: files written through the page cache of a KRFFS root mounted from a disk on the q35 machine's own AHCI controller at 0:31.2, larger together than the cache, synced and read back, keep every byte

execution.privileges: root, which writes the root directory
execution.cleanup: it removes each file that compares equal; the disk is the attempt's private copy

assertions.checks: each of the 24 files of 256 KiB opens, is written whole and is synced
each file opens again and reads back whole
every byte read back equals the pattern of its file and offset

native.reason: the page cache's window it tests exists only for a KRFFS root that rach2.fsdisk mounts from the boot disk
